title: 导师的办公室
scene: 毕业论文开题前的谈话

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: Come in. I received your invitation to the lab demo — thanks.
lines.zh: 请进。我收到了实验室演示的邀请——谢谢。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Of course. Your approval means a lot to our project.
lines.zh: 应该的。您的批准对我们的项目太重要了。

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: Before anything: what is your ___ for this topic?
lines.zh: 先说清楚：你选这个题目的动机是什么？

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Cheap sensors are enormous in number but poor in quality. I want to fix that.
lines.zh: 廉价的传感器数量庞大但质量很差，我想解决这个问题。

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: A wise goal. But external noise will harm your data.
lines.zh: 目标很有智慧。但外部噪声会损害你的数据。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: ___ we add a filter, the error stays under 2 percent.
lines.zh: 只要加装一个滤波器，误差就能保持在 2% 以内。

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: Good. Now revise chapter two — the theory part feels half-finished.
lines.zh: 好。现在去修订第二章——理论部分写得像半成品。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: I'll rewrite it tonight and ___ on the core proof.
lines.zh: 我今晚就重写，集中精力攻克核心证明。

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: Don't spoil your health for it. Wisdom includes resting.
lines.zh: 别为此搞垮身体。会休息也是一种智慧。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Understood. I'll perform the final test next Monday instead.
lines.zh: 明白。那我改到下周一再做最终测试。

lines.name: Dr. Chen
lines.en: Perfect. Send me the draft before Friday — nowhere else to be by then.
lines.zh: 好。周五前把草稿发我——那之前我也没有别的安排。

lines.name: 你
lines.en: Will do. Thank you, Dr. Chen!
